verdict.rationale: Codex CLI supports natural-language driven debugging workflows—exploring code, running local commands, reviewing diffs, accepting error screenshots for context, and even running dedicated code reviews—all documented as agentic features (codex-docs-9, codex-docs-10, codex-docs-12). However community feedback is mixed, citing inconsistent quality ('struggles with almost anything'), slowness, and sandboxing friction that can hamper real troubleshooting sessions (codex-comm-3, codex-comm-12, codex-comm-7).
